name: Cross-chain narrative demand pair
hypothesis: Buy the stronger eligible token basket and hedge only with authorized liquid exposure, using prepositioned capital.
spec: Setup: A theme may gain independent demand on one chain before another. Entry: Buy the stronger eligible token basket and hedge only with authorized liquid exposure, using prepositioned capital. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on relative-demand reversal or chain execution stress. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs hedgeable short legs or float estimates for memecoins
